title: Interior and Radiators
author: Cyrus Whitlock
blurb: Lena Iversen, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
